Watcom field-by-field struct copy (3 consecutive `dst.field = src.field;` lines). Replace with `dst = src;` or `memcpy(&dst, &src, sizeof(...));` in a .keep — but only once the run (together with any sibling runs for the same dst/src pair) covers every byte of the struct. Collapsing a run that leaves a gap WIDENS the copy and changes behaviour; see `partial_struct_copy` (§31) for that case.
Watcom cascade constant fill (3 sibling fields chained through prior store of `0.0`). Replace with 3 direct stores of the constant in a .keep.

Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `pCVar6` was initialized to the address of an array element's subfield (`pCVar6 = &BASE->ARR[K].SUBFIELD;`) and is advanced here by `+ N` whole pointees, where `N * sizeof(*pCVar6)` equals the array's element stride. The pointer is a smaller-typed walker striding a larger struct array. Replace the `pCVar6->subfield` reads with direct indexing on the original array (`BASE->ARR[i].SUBFIELD`); drop the shadow init and advance.
